name: Time Freeze
prompt: Time freezes: the person is frozen mid-motion in a crisp bullet-time shot while dust, water droplets, leaves and sparks hang motionless in the air all around them, a faint blue shimmer ripples outward through the frozen scene, cinematic VFX shot, the person stays in the same place and the camera, lighting and background match the original footage
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped body, flickering, watermark, text, subtitles, cartoon, deformed hands
